idea-plugin.name: RecordRelay
idea-plugin.description:
RecordRelay — Universal database record transfer across environments.

Transfer any database record (and all its related child rows) between PostgreSQL or MySQL databases safely, with environment-based direction rules that prevent upstream data flow.

Features:
  • Works with any table structure — configure root table + FK column
  • PostgreSQL and MySQL / MariaDB support
  • Environment hierarchy rules (PROD → TEST → LOCAL only)
  • Dry-run preview mode
  • Transfer profiles for reusable configurations
  • Shared history with the RecordRelay desktop app
  • Field value overrides for environment-specific values
idea-plugin.change-notes: 3.0.0 — Initial release of the universal RecordRelay plugin. Supports PostgreSQL and MySQL, configurable environments, transfer profiles, and dry-run mode.
